goals.text: Collect S-K-A-T-E; Collect 5 Hall Passes; Grind 3 Roll Call Rails; Kickflip TC's Roof Gap; Get the Secret Tape; Wallride 5 Bells (plus stat points, Vicarious Visions logo, alien plushie)

size.footprint: ≈ 150–200 × 100–140 m walkable bounding box across nine districts; the library courtyard alone ≈ 60–70 × 35–40 m
size.evidence: VG scale anchored on the TC's Roof portables (≈ 7–8 m wide, typical portable classroom) giving ≈ 0.08 m per map pixel; cross-check: the gym court then measures ≈ 26 m, a regulation high-school court; the K quarter pipe to library planter run-up then measures ≈ 39 m, matching LP2's ≈ 4 s at skating speed (17:07–17:11). Low confidence

spawn.facing: north-west along the terrace, the hall entrance to the right and the stairs down to the left (LP2 11:40)
spawn.notes: LP2 11:40–11:43: the run opens on the raised terrace with a kicker and quarter pipe ahead, buildings close around, and a bell on the right-hand wall that LP2 wallrides 5 s after spawn. The tape is far away (≈ 100 m) behind two rows of buildings and is not visible; nor is any letter. The opening invites three choices: right into the hall (bell, pass, S), down the Nightmare stairs or Leap Of Faith into the table court, or a wallride onto the roofs (Crazy Roof Gap line).

collectibles.failure: A weak or misaligned planter launch bounces off the library wall into the courtyard: re-pump at the quarter pipe ≈ 40 m back, ≈ 8–12 s. A missed tape drops into the gap or Carlsbad, a walled lower district whose exits (Over The Wall..., And Down The Bank!) lead to the lower courtyard far from the library: ≈ 30+ s and usually the rest of the run (LP2 ends that run in Carlsbad, 17:40)
collectibles.timeFromSpawnS: LP2 run 3: spawn 16:10, tape 17:15 (65 s, with a detour along the awning for a $100). First quarter-pipe contact to tape = 15 s (17:00 → 17:15); launch to tape ≈ 3–4 s
collectibles.why: The tape is the entrance exam for Carlsbad, the level's last district. It reuses the courtyard's own features (letter ramp, stage, planter) as one straight speed line, then asks for a second commitment off the roof edge.

guidance: Hall passes are big orange signs on posts readable from across a court (LP2 11:46, 11:52); the shrine calls them 'big and obvious'.
Bells sit on walls at wallride height, each beside a small ramp or flat run-up; the first is 5 s from spawn.
The letter order S→K→A→T→E follows one continuous path through the hall, stage, library stairs and lower courtyard (shrine).
The courtyard's crest wall and big quarter pipe are the K landmark; faint tire treads on the stage point toward the library and its planter, a built-in arrow for the tape line (shrine).
The tape is deliberately hidden from the ground: it appears only after the player is on the library roof (LP2 17:14).
Carlsbad is walled off and seen from the roofs as a green lower district (LP2 17:17); its exit ramp is visible from the lower courtyard as a ramp over the wall.

The gym's closed blue doors are shown to everyone collecting pass 3. The only in-game clue to opening them is the bell ringing at the run's start; the rule itself comes from guides (the VG annotation).
designLogic: Letters teach the route and the gym tests it: the S→K→A order runs from spawn to the Opunsezmee rail. Skated within ≈ 19 s, while the bell rings, that same line opens the gym.
The tape is the entrance exam to Carlsbad: getting it and discovering the level's last district are one action, and a miss drops you into that district anyway (exploration as consolation).

The tape line reuses the main court's furniture: the letter K's quarter pipe for speed, the stage for a straight run-up (tire treads as guide), the planter as a kicker. Nothing new is built for it; the target is simply higher.
Two commitments in sequence: the launch (2 Da Roof!!!) is the hard part but fails cheaply; the roof-edge gap is easier but fails expensively (Carlsbad). Risk is pushed after the skill check.

Roofs are a second reading of the school: a low roof chain from the start (Crazy and Suicidal Roof Gaps) and a high pair (library, East Wing). The tape uses the highest pair; the TC's Roof kickflip goal teaches roof gaps first on ≈ 3 m portables.
Wallride is taught by goal: five bells, the first beside spawn. THPS2's new move becomes navigation for the awning route (LP2 16:48–16:49).

Goal objects tour the districts: hall passes cover start, table court, gym front and lower courtyard (twice); bells cover start, centre, two far corners and the tape's flagpole area; roll-call rails cover three courts.

The secret gym is timing-gated and optional: failing it costs a whole new run because the window is at the run's start. It holds no goal or cash in the original, only the level's biggest lip gaps (High Dive Extension 5,000).
Cash forces exploration: Carlsbad holds $150 of the $750, so 100% requires the tape line or a roof crossing; LP2's final cash comes off the centre roofs (18:04–18:16).
Size and the 2:00 limit force run planning: LP2 needs four runs (scores, letters, bells and passes; TC's gap and rails; tape; leftover cash), against one run for the Hangar.
Spawn is a decision point with three exits (hall, stairs/drop, roofs), each starting a different line within 5 s.
The tape is placed over a big drop: THPS2 shows its Big Drop warning at the pickup (LP2 17:15), so the reward moment is also the moment of greatest exposure.
remakeChanges: Scores: Pro 40,000 → 70,000, Sick 100,000 → 125,000; a High Combo goal (10,000) is added (LP2 checklist vs PS12).

Tape: PS12 describes the original line (raised quarter pipe for speed, straight at the library, planter launch, tape between the flags). Thumbsticks and Screenrant (1+2) describe another: boost off a planter ramp onto the awning, wallride/grind up to the library roof, stop, then ride a ramp off the roof to the tape. Halfglass places it between the library and the East Wing. The remake keeps the location and supports a slower, more controllable approach via the awnings (inference from the texts).
LP12 shows an EAST WING sign over a door (0:46:28), naming the building the tape gap faces.

Gym: 1+2 still opens it by grinding the Opunsezmee rail as the bell rings, and it stays unlocked afterwards (Gamertweak; the THPS HD Steam thread reports the same for HD). LP12's last School II run is inside the pool (0:48:28).

1+2 adds collectibles inside the formerly empty secret: stat points above the gym pool and on its wall ledge, and the Vicarious Visions logo above the gym hoop. The secret gym gains collectible value in the remake.
1+2 adds an alien plushie on the courtyard awning and several roof-top stat points, including one reached by jumping from the library roof across to the next roof.
Gap list: VG's 'Are You Serious?!!' (AC-unit roof) is absent from PS12's 1+2 list; all other VG names appear in PS12.
transfer: Roof-doorway crystal: hang the crystal ≈ 0.5–1 m above roof level in the gap between two tall roofs that lead into a walled bonus district. The approach is a quarter-pipe pump (two vert airs), a straight 35–45 m run (a speed pad can stand in for THPS2's special), a launch onto the first roof, a 10–15 m roll, then an ollie off the edge. This game's full ollie (≈ 9.4 m long at cruise, ≈ 13.8 m at charge) can cover a 6–10 m gap.

Height budget: THPS2 jumps ≈ 6–8 m from a planter. Here, put a vert quarter pipe or kicker ramp against the façade (or a trampoline disguised as a planter) to reach the first roof; do not rely on a flat ollie (1.78 m).
Angled flagpoles as exit rails: two or three trick rails jutting from the far wall below the crystal give a grind catch for a short jump, and the grind dumps the player into the bonus district.
Timed bell gate: a trick gate that opens only if a named rail is ground during a window early in the run, announced by an audio cue (the bell). Mark the rail with a pickup so players ride it anyway.

Breadcrumbs that become a speed test: place 3 pickups along the route from spawn to that rail (hall ledge, stage quarter pipe, stair rail) so collecting them teaches the line the timed gate later demands.
Wallride targets as teachers: put the first wallride target within 5 s of spawn, then use wallride-plus-wallie onto an awning as a real route to the crystal's roof.

Asymmetric failure: make the launch the hard part with a short retry (≈ 10 s) and the final gap the easy part with a long consequence (dropped into the bonus district), so failure still shows new space.
openQuestions: The exact gym window: VG says within 19 s of starting the run, HD users report timer 1:44–1:40, and 1+2 guides tie it to the bell's ring. Whether the original's window is exactly the bell's duration was not verified (LP2 never opens the gym).
Whether the original gym, once opened, stays open in later runs (claimed for HD and 1+2 only).
Original gap point values (only 1+2 values from PS12) and the value of 'Are You Serious?!!'.
Heights and the footprint are estimates (VG scale assumption ≈ 0.08 m/px).
Which bell description in the shrine and PS12 matches which VG bell icon is partly ambiguous (two texts mention a dumpster).

Whether the remake's awning route to the tape (Thumbsticks/Screenrant) also works in the PS1 original (awning wallrides exist in LP2 16:48–16:56, but no PS1 source describes reaching the library roof that way).
